query: WITH matched AS ( SELECT s.id FROM series s WHERE s.normalized_title % $1 UNION SELECT st.series_id FROM series_titles st WHERE st.normalized % $1 ), ranked AS ( SELECT s.id, s.normalized_title, s.content_type, s.release_year, GREATEST( similarity(s.normalized_title, $1), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(similarity(st.normalized, $1)) FROM series_titles st WHERE st.series_id = s.id), 0) ) AS sim FROM series s JOIN matched m ON m.id = s.id ORDER BY sim DESC LIMIT $2 ) SELECT r.id, r.normalized_title, r.content_type AS "content_type: ContentType", r.release_year, r.sim AS "sim!", COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(st.normalized) FROM series_titles st WHERE st.series_id = r.id), '{}') AS "alt_titles!", COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(t.name) FROM series_tags stg JOIN tags t ON t.id = stg.tag_id WHERE stg.series_id = r.id), '{}') AS "tags!", COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(a.name) FROM series_authors sa JOIN authors a ON a.id = sa.author_id WHERE sa.series_id = r.id), '{}') AS "authors!" FROM ranked r ORDER BY r.sim DESC
